_comment_top: spaarke-ai-architecture-redesign-r1 task 040 (FR-P3-01) — seed rows for the Insights ask/search Binding registrations. These rows REPLACE the deleted 'Insights:Playbooks:Map' appsettings block and the 'Insights:Playbooks:DefaultName' config key (single-routing-surface rule, ADR-039): the canonical playbook name lives in sprk_consumercode; the per-environment sprk_analysisplaybook GUID lives in the sprk_playbook lookup.
_comment_resolution: Readers (InsightEndpoints.Ask, AssistantToolCallHandler, InsightsOrchestrator, TopicRegistryTtlLookup) resolve via IConsumerRoutingService.ResolveBindingAsync(ConsumerTypes.InsightsAsk, consumerCode: <canonicalName>) with EXACT consumer-code matching — the 'default'-row fallback of the resolution algorithm is rejected by the callers so an unknown canonical name still 400s (the pre-cutover contract). The 'default' row itself serves the Assistant-path default (classifier bypassed, no hint).
_comment_ingest: universal-ingest@v1 has NO row in dev (it was never configured in the map either — reserved for r2 catch-up). RunIngestAsync's exact-code resolution therefore returns no match and keeps its honest unconfigured error. When the playbook deploys, seed one more insights-ask row with sprk_consumercode 'universal-ingest@v1'.
_comment_search: The insights-search row is the catalog registration for the RAG search surface (POST /api/insights/search wraps IRagService — no engine target exists). It carries NO sprk_playbook/sprk_action: no code resolves it today; it exists for the FR-P0-04 constants↔rows boot-reconciliation parity of ConsumerTypes.InsightsSearch and as the anchor for the later loop-side insights capability projection. Neither insights row carries sprk_tooldescription — they are NOT loop-projected yet (loop-side insights capabilities are a later catalog addition, same posture as the daily-briefing task-043 note).
